one_line: OpenAI rolls out policy push and infrastructure tools as AI firms secure massive funding and benchmarks advance.

themes.title: OpenAI pushes policy and infrastructure
themes.text: OpenAI will start a policy and public‑relations campaign after the U.S. midterm elections, proposing mandatory safety safeguards, speed limits on advanced AI, and rebranding its data centers as AI compute campuses. It also announced a Grid Protectors Program to partner with utilities on compute campus power reliability and will merge the Chat and Work tabs in its desktop app for select users.

stories.headline: OpenAI to launch post‑midterm policy push, propose AI speed limits and rename data centers
OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program to aid utilities with compute campus power reliability
OpenAI to merge Chat and Work tabs in ChatGPT desktop app for select users

themes.title: AI companies secure major financing
themes.text: OpenAI cut its fundraising target to $20 billion after securing $11 billion, while Hex Technologies raised $100 million Series D, Anthropic seeks up to ¥552.9 billion in its U.S. IPO, and Oracle announced $20 billion of stock and bond sales for AI data‑center expansion. Alphabet sold €6 billion in bonds with €17 billion demand, Saudi Aramco invested $2.6 billion for a 49 % stake in Humain, and Vera Health, Casap and Bites together raised $28.5 million, $56 million and $40 million respectively to grow AI‑driven services.

themes.title: AI benchmarks and satellite test
themes.text: SemiAnalysis released the GDPx benchmark testing 206 agentic tasks across 11 professional domains, where Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 achieved the highest average score of 12 %. Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite ran the Gemma 4 language model on a data‑centre‑class TPU and returned a haiku about space during its first ground‑station pass.
